name: SwitchLinc Dimmer
description: The SwitchLinc dimmers, which run the KeypadLinc code base with a single load and no button masks.

enumerations.name: triggerLevel
enumerations.description: Which level a triggered group sets the local load to.

enumerations.name: triggerRampRate
enumerations.description: How fast a triggered group changes the local load.

values.name: localRampRate
values.description: At the local load's ramp rate.

enumerations.name: setButtonTap
enumerations.description: What a remote SET button tap sets.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: resumeDim
operatingFlags.description: Turning the load on at the device restores its last level instead of the on-level.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.description: The status LEDs and button backlights are off.

verification.note: One source swaps 0x08 and 0x09 (backlight on and off); the values here are those other sources give. The Insteon Developer's Guide reads bit 4 of the 0x00 reply as LED on, but later sources read it as LED off, the state 0x08 sets.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide gives bit 5 of the 0x00 reply as load sense, set with 0x06 and 0x07, and the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes also call it load sense but set key beep with 0x0A and 0x0B; the KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes make bit 5 key beep on the code base these dimmers run, as used here.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the powerline is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: applicationRetries
operatingFlags.description: The device retries application messages as many times as its ALL-Link database says, and reports cleanup errors.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when a communication error occurs.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

operatingFlags.name: checksumRequired
operatingFlags.description: Extended Set and ALL-Link database write messages must carry a checksum in D14.

operatingFlags.name: longHoldoff
operatingFlags.description: The device holds off 8 times as long before sending, 16 to 72 zero crossings rather than 2 to 9.

verification.note: Only the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes list this bit for a SwitchLinc, as BigHoldOff, and they list cmd2 0x1A and 0x1B as unused; its meaning is read from the Global Line Developer Notes, which set it with 0x1B. On the KeypadLinc the same bit is detach load.

operatingFlags.name: smartHops
operatingFlags.description: Each message starts with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops). When the bit is 0, each message starts with one hop.

verification.note: Read from the KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes and Global Line Developer Notes, which name bit 6 of the 0x05 reply smart hops, or IA start hops, and set it with cmd2 0x1C; the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes list the bit but give cmd2 0x1C and 0x1D as unused.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide gives query 0x02 as a signal-to-noise value; later sources count messages with CRC errors there.

flagCommands.name: yakityYakOff
flagCommands.description: Turns the Yakity Yak signaling option off.

flagCommands.name: yakityYakOn
flagCommands.description: Turns the Yakity Yak signaling option on.

flagCommands.name: modSyncFailureNoHop
flagCommands.description: When modulation sync fails, the device doesn't hop the message.

flagCommands.name: modSyncFailureOwnZeroCrossing
flagCommands.description: When modulation sync fails, the device uses its own zero crossing.

flagCommands.name: pushHopsToRadioOn
flagCommands.description: The device repeats every powerline hop over RF.

flagCommands.name: pushHopsToRadioOff
flagCommands.description: The device doesn't repeat every powerline hop over RF.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

values.name: ledBrightness
values.description: The brightness of the status LEDs, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest).

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LED.

writes.name: maxRetries
writes.description: Sets how many times the device retries a message, from 0x01 to 0xFF. 0x00 restores the factory default of 5.

notes: Earlier sources give ramp rates 0x00 through 0x1F as 9 minutes down to 0.1 second; the later ones make 0x01 8 minutes and 0x00 2 seconds.

standardCommands.name: lightOn
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 at the saved ramp rate.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOnFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at the saved ramp rate. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: lightOffFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off instantly. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

standardCommands.name: instantChange
standardCommands.description: Sets the load to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: remoteSetButtonTap
standardCommands.description: Acts as a tap of the SET button: sets the on-level or the ramp rate from the load's present level, so turn the load to that level first.

verification.note: The SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes send 0x00 to set the on-level and 0x02 the ramp rate, as used here; the Insteon Developer's Guide calls 0x00 unused and counts taps in cmd2, one tap 0x01 and two 0x02.

standardCommands.name: onAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to a level at a ramp rate, both given in cmd2.

parameter.name: levelAndRampRate
parameter.description: Bits 4 through 7 give the level, which is 16 times their value plus 0x0F, and bits 0 through 3 the ramp rate, which is 2 times their value plus 1.

verification.note: The SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes give the level as 16 times bits 4 through 7 plus 0x0F and the ramp rate as 2 times bits 0 through 3 plus 1, as used here; the Insteon Developer's Guide prints bits 4 through 7 as the on-level plus 0x0F and bits 0 through 3 as 2 times the ramp rate plus 1.

standardCommands.name: offAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at a ramp rate given in cmd2. Bits 4 through 7 are 0.

parameter.name: rampRate
parameter.description: The ramp rate, which is 2 times this value plus 1.

verification.note: Read from the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes and the KeypadLinc code base; the Insteon Developer's Guide reserves standard commands 0x2F through 0x3F.

standardCommands.name: beep
standardCommands.description: Beeps once, as pressing the SET button does. The device ignores cmd2.

verification.note: Read from the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes and the KeypadLinc code base; the Insteon Developer's Guide reserves standard commands 0x2F through 0x3F.

extendedCommands.name: triggerGroup
extendedCommands.description: Acts as if group D1's button had been pressed: sends the cmd1 and cmd2 in D4 and D5 to group D1, and sets the local load as D2, D3 and D6 say. The device doesn't parse the command it sends, so to turn the local load off, put 0x01 in D2 and 0x00 in D3.

parameters.name: levelSource
parameters.description: Which level the local load goes to.

parameters.name: onLevel
parameters.description: The level the local load goes to when D2 is 0x01.

parameters.name: groupCommand1
parameters.description: The cmd1 to send to the group.

parameters.name: groupCommand2
parameters.description: The cmd2 to send to the group.

parameters.name: rampRate
parameters.description: How fast the local load changes.

verification.note: The SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes make D2 and D6 0x00 the local on-level and ramp rate, as used here; the Insteon Developer's Guide makes them the on-level and ramp rate stored in the ALL-Link database.
